patch_description:
This version replaces height balancing with a future-activation strategy. When boxes above the current target must be moved, it chooses the destination stack whose smallest remaining box number is largest. That stack is expected to be needed later than the others, so the moved block is less likely to be picked up again soon and incur repeated movement cost.

Empty stacks are treated as having an infinite minimum value, making them preferred whenever available. Ties are resolved by smaller stack height to reduce the cost of any later relocation.
